title: Home
text:
Home


Statistics · Financial modelling
Kyungsub Lee이경섭

Professor, Department of StatisticsYeungnam University
I use probability and statistics to understand the dynamics of financial markets, exploring the mathematical structures underlying randomness and uncertainty.

I pursue research out of personal curiosity, with the hope of contributing to better ways of advancing human understanding.

Google Scholar ↗
ORCID ↗
GitHub ↗



Contact
ksublee@yu.ac.kr
Department of StatisticsYeungnam UniversityGyeongsan, Republic of Korea
Research interests

Stochastic processes
Financial market dynamics
Volatility and long memory
Hawkes and point processes





Research themes


Events & market dynamics
Point-process models of price changes, order arrivals, and durations in high-frequency financial markets.


Volatility & memory
GARCH-type models, persistent volatility, and finite-dimensional representations of slowly decaying dynamics.


Inference & computation
Statistical estimation and simulation for financial data and risk measurement.
